methodology: Unlike the conservative baseline (which used only committed JSON metadata and explicitly did not read golden repository source), this document opens each row's evidence_scope file, and any local import it directly names, inside the read-only frozen-commit checkouts at /private/tmp/cejel-v19-owner-review-golden-20260729.

For each row, the applicable rule's required-evidence checklist (docs/packs/free-llm-v1-rule-contract.md) is applied to what is actually observable in the anchored file: does the anchored file itself contain every element the checklist requires (file_local), or does resolving at least one required element (a producer/judge/config identity, a validation/authority-gate path, a secret-source-to-sink path, or a case-iteration/aggregation chain) require reading a second, different file or module (cross_module)?

A row is recorded file_local only when every required element is textually present or locally defined in the anchored file itself. A row is recorded cross_module, non-ambiguous, when a concrete second file or module is identified by name and its role in supplying a required element is confirmed by reading it. A row is recorded ambiguous only when, after attempting this, the actual second-file dependency (if any) still cannot be pinned down concretely from the checked-out source -- this document reports zero such rows; every one of the 34 anchored files led to an identifiable, concretely-cited second file or module.

No detector, recognition logic, golden label, cohort manifest, rule, manifest, or prior v1.9 result file was run, modified, or relabeled.
